items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: I knew him very well. Yeah. Well, then we played together for a while... Me, Arthur Durdne, Whitney Arsenault... and Dr. Bechier.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. I've heard of him. Had a brass band.

Had a brass band. And he had charge of the WPA band too some time back. And now, I've taken a few lessons with David Jones. Oh, yeah. I was on tenor saxophone. And I come in to play any different little bands. Well, our first band was then, if I'm not making a mistake, it's the Imperial. Well, Jack August was playing alto saxophone. I was playing the clarinet. Willie Webber was playing trumpet. And Dr. Bechier, who was that? Oh, yeah. He played trombone? Oh, he was playing trombone. I knew him very well. Yeah.…
that straight. It wasn't that part of Sam's band. Yeah. Well, that's before we joined the band
